DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_DomeArmorDragon:
In ancient times, when means of communication were limited, 
the light within <characterName id=|DomeArmorDragon|/>'s wings was used to send simple flash signals.

Drops compressed <itemName id=|Thermal_Core| style=|Status_Keyword|/> from its wings when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_ClownRabbit:
A copy it created might quietly replace it, 
leaving even the <characterName id=|ClownRabbit|/> itself unsure whether it is still the original.

Collects ancient relics across dimensions through its magical hat when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_GrassMinotaur_Ice:
Its frozen horn stays solid through its life.
When water begins to drip from this ice,
<characterName id=|GrassMinotaur_Ice|/> feels the chill of its own life slipping away.

Sheds pieces of <itemName id=|Wood_WorldTree| style=|Status_Keyword|/> off its skin when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_RockBeast:
It smashes its body against harder rocks to maintain its preferred shape.
Those with noticeable dents are best left alone, much like people with a botched haircut.

Sheds fragments of <itemName id=|Quartz| style=|Status_Keyword|/> when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_RockBeast_Ice:
It basks in the sun, rotating just enough to melt its ice into its preferred shape.
Lopsided ones should be left alone, much like a person who was a little too bold with their sideburns.

Sheds fragments of <itemName id=|WorldTreeOre| style=|Status_Keyword|/> when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_SnakeGirl:
Whenever it's confused, it resorts to consulting with the snakes on its head.
However, since they're all ultimately the same being, it comes to understand that nothing is understood.

Prolonged world tree exposure allows <characterName id=|SnakeGirl|/> to mix its saliva and venom to create <itemName id=|WorldTreeHolyWater| style=|Status_Keyword|/> when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_MoonChild:
At the end of its life, a new star appears somewhere in the skies, 
glowing with the weight of its memories.

Attracts <itemName id=|PalUpgradeStone| style=|Status_Keyword|/> from the stars while assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
